correctness.rationale: Explicit interpolation has exactly one slope −(n−1) branch and otherwise integer translations. Its residue-class directed graph has one renewal strongly connected component of length m−1 and d−1 deterministic m-cycles, giving the determinant and entropy. Each deterministic cycle composes to the identity, and expansion on any itinerary traversing the fold rules out other identity intervals. For coprime q every closed Markov word visits the fold and therefore has a unique periodic fixed point; periodic integer boundaries visit both unique-coded endpoints and are not overcounted, proving trace counts and the zeta formula at every iterate. The included checker passes 90 finite cases and 15,932 exact periodic-address tests; these verify, rather than prove, the infinite quantifiers.
